cards.title: About FIT Format
cards.body: FIT (Flexible and Interoperable Data Transfer) is Garmin's proprietary binary format for storing fitness and activity data. It's used by Garmin watches, bike computers, and other fitness devices to store workouts, routes, heart rate, power, and other metrics.

cards.title: About GPX Format
cards.body: GPX (GPS Exchange Format) is an open XML standard for GPS data. It's widely supported by fitness platforms (Strava, Komoot), mapping software (Google Earth, QGIS), and navigation apps.

cards.title: Why Convert FIT to GPX?
items: Import activities into platforms that don't support FIT files
Share routes with users on different platforms
View your data in mapping software like Google Earth
Create backups in an open, human-readable format
Edit or combine activities using GPX-compatible tools

privacyBody: All conversion happens entirely in your browser. Your fitness data never leaves your device and is not sent to any server.
